description: The plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and accuracy for the MMLU Pro dataset, comparing Final Accuracy, $\Delta$ Accuracy, and Initial Accuracy. The x-axis is labeled "Initial Confidence" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.81 to 0.99, with tick marks at specific data points (0.81, 0.82, and 0.84 through 0.99 in increments of 0.01). The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The "Final Accuracy" is represented by a solid blue line with cross markers, starting at approximately 0.95 at an initial confidence of 0.81, fluctuating slightly with a dip to roughly 0.85 at 0.88, and ending at approximately 0.95 at 0.99. The "$\Delta$ Accuracy" is shown as a dashed orange line with upward-pointing triangle markers, beginning at roughly 0.45 at 0.81, dropping to a low of about 0.15 at 0.87, peaking again near 0.45 at 0.89, and declining to approximately 0.05 at 0.99. The "Initial Accuracy" is depicted by a dash-dot green line with circular markers, starting at about 0.5 at 0.81 and showing a general upward trend to end at approximately 0.9 at 0.99. All lines include vertical error bars at each data point.
